services:

  user-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: finance-ms-user-postgres

    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: user_db
      POSTGRES_USER: finance
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: finance
      TZ: UTC
      PGTZ: UTC

    volumes:
      - finance_ms_user_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data

    healthcheck:
      test:
        [
          "CMD-SHELL",
          "pg_isready -U finance -d user_db"
        ]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10


  discovery-server:
    image: maven:3.9.9-eclipse-temurin-21
    container_name: finance-ms-discovery

    working_dir: /workspace

    volumes:
      - ./discovery-server:/workspace
      - finance_ms_maven_cache:/root/.m2

    ports:
      - "8761:8761"

    environment:
      TZ: UTC
      JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS: -Duser.timezone=UTC

    command:
      - mvn
      - spring-boot:run


  user-service:

    image: maven:3.9.9-eclipse-temurin-21

    container_name:
      finance-ms-user-service

    working_dir:
      /workspace

    volumes:
      - ./user-service:/workspace
      - finance_ms_maven_cache:/root/.m2

    ports:
      - "8081:8081"

    environment:

      TZ: UTC

      JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS:
        -Duser.timezone=UTC

      SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL:
        jdbc:postgresql://user-postgres:5432/user_db

      SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME:
        finance

      SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD:
        finance

      EUREKA_SERVER_URL:
        http://discovery-server:8761/eureka/

      SPRING_RABBITMQ_HOST:
        rabbitmq

      SPRING_RABBITMQ_PORT:
        5672

      SPRING_RABBITMQ_USERNAME:
        finance

      SPRING_RABBITMQ_PASSWORD:
        finance

    depends_on:

      user-postgres:
        condition: service_healthy

      discovery-server:
        condition: service_started

      rabbitmq:
        condition: service_healthy

    command:
      - mvn
      - spring-boot:run
  market-service:

    image:
      maven:3.9.9-eclipse-temurin-21

    container_name:
      finance-ms-market-service

    working_dir:
      /workspace

    volumes:

      - ./market-service:/workspace

      - finance_ms_maven_cache:/root/.m2

    ports:

      - "8082:8082"

    environment:

      TZ: UTC

      JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS:
        -Duser.timezone=UTC

      EUREKA_SERVER_URL:
        http://discovery-server:8761/eureka/

    depends_on:

      discovery-server:
        condition: service_started

    command:

      - mvn

      - spring-boot:run

  
  trade-postgres:

    image: postgres:16-alpine

    container_name:
      finance-ms-trade-postgres

    environment:

      POSTGRES_DB:
        trade_db

      POSTGRES_USER:
        finance

      POSTGRES_PASSWORD:
        finance

      TZ:
        UTC

      PGTZ:
        UTC

    volumes:

      - finance_ms_trade_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data

    healthcheck:

      test:
        [
          "CMD-SHELL",
          "pg_isready -U finance -d trade_db"
        ]

      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10


  trade-service:

    image:
      maven:3.9.9-eclipse-temurin-21

    container_name:
      finance-ms-trade-service

    working_dir:
      /workspace

    volumes:

      - ./trade-service:/workspace

      - finance_ms_maven_cache:/root/.m2

    ports:

      - "8083:8083"

    environment:

      TZ:
        UTC

      JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS:
        -Duser.timezone=UTC

      SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL:
        jdbc:postgresql://trade-postgres:5432/trade_db

      SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME:
        finance

      SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD:
        finance

      EUREKA_SERVER_URL:
        http://discovery-server:8761/eureka/
      
      SPRING_RABBITMQ_HOST:
        rabbitmq

      SPRING_RABBITMQ_PORT:
        5672

      SPRING_RABBITMQ_USERNAME:
        finance

      SPRING_RABBITMQ_PASSWORD:
        finance

    depends_on:

      trade-postgres:
        condition: service_healthy

      discovery-server:
        condition: service_started

      user-service:
        condition: service_started

      market-service:
        condition: service_started

      rabbitmq:
        condition: service_healthy

    command:

      - mvn

      - spring-boot:run

  api-gateway:

    image:
      maven:3.9.9-eclipse-temurin-21

    container_name:
      finance-ms-api-gateway

    working_dir:
      /workspace

    volumes:

      - ./api-gateway:/workspace

      - finance_ms_maven_cache:/root/.m2

    ports:

      - "8080:8080"

    environment:

      TZ:
        UTC

      JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS:
        -Duser.timezone=UTC

      EUREKA_SERVER_URL:
        http://discovery-server:8761/eureka/

    depends_on:

      discovery-server:
        condition: service_started

      user-service:
        condition: service_started

      market-service:
        condition: service_started

      trade-service:
        condition: service_started

    command:

      - mvn

      - spring-boot:run


  rabbitmq:

    image:
      rabbitmq:3-management-alpine

    container_name:
      finance-ms-rabbitmq

    environment:

      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER:
        finance

      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS:
        finance

    ports:

      - "5672:5672"
      - "15672:15672"

    volumes:

      - finance_ms_rabbitmq_data:/var/lib/rabbitmq

    healthcheck:

      test:
        [
          "CMD",
          "rabbitmq-diagnostics",
          "-q",
          "ping"
        ]

      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  e2e-tests:

    image:
      maven:3.9.9-eclipse-temurin-21

    working_dir:
      /workspace

    volumes:

      - ./e2e-tests:/workspace

      - finance_ms_maven_cache:/root/.m2

    environment:

      BASE_URL:
        http://api-gateway:8080

    depends_on:

      api-gateway:
        condition: service_started

      user-service:
        condition: service_started

      market-service:
        condition: service_started

      trade-service:
        condition: service_started

    profiles:
      - test
volumes:

  finance_ms_user_data:

  finance_ms_trade_data:

  finance_ms_rabbitmq_data:

  finance_ms_maven_cache:

  application:
    name: market-service


server:

  port: 8082

    service-url:

      defaultZone:
        ${EUREKA_SERVER_URL:http://discovery-server:8761/eureka/}

    prefer-ip-address: true

  endpoints:

    web:

      exposure:

        include:
          - health
          - info

spring:

  application:
    name: api-gateway

  cloud:

    gateway:

      server:

        webflux:

          routes:

            - id: user-service
              uri: lb://user-service
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/users

            - id: market-service
              uri: lb://market-service
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/quotes/**

            - id: trade-service
              uri: lb://trade-service
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/trades/**

            - id: portfolio-service
              uri: lb://trade-service
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/users/*/portfolio

            - id: history-service
              uri: lb://trade-service
              predicates:
                - Path=/api/users/*/trades

item.text: The baseline has service entry points and routing, but no domain endpoints yet. I’ll keep account and position state in user-service, calculate portfolios there, and store trade history in trade-service. Trade-service will coordinate through Feign and Eureka.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('user-service/pom.xml')
s=p.read_text()
needle='    <dependencies>\\n'
s=s.replace(needle,needle+'\\n        <dependency>\\n            <groupId>org.springframework.cloud</groupId>\\n            <artifactId>spring-cloud-starter-openfeign</artifactId>\\n        </dependency>\\n',1)

item.text:
Implemented the financial API across the existing services. Market-service serves the five fixed quotes; user-service owns users, cash, positions, and portfolio totals; trade-service coordinates buys and sells, stores history in its own database, and publishes completed-trade audit events. The gateway routes the public paths to those services. Rejected trades leave cash and positions unchanged and create no trade record.

I validated the Maven POMs and service YAML files. I could not run a build because Maven is not installed in the workspace; the orchestrator still needs to build and run the external acceptance suite.
